edition.authority: Archbishop Johannes of Bremen willed and assented to the new printing in a commission dated 31 August 1511, printed on the title verso. He describes a shortage of missals and worn books with disordered arrangement, and the insertion of many new feasts and patronal histories; he urges diocesan priests lacking suitable books to obtain copies.
edition.publication: Strasbourg: Renatus Beck, at the expense of Caspar de Mellerstat, 12 September 1511; corrected by Heinrich Nortman.
edition.title: Missale secundum ritum ecclesie Bremensis
